summary.oneLiner: Pioneer and market leader in India's community boiler model, generating and centrally distributing industrial gases (steam and nitrogen) to clustered industrial customers through its own pipeline network in Gujarat.
summary.business: Steamhouse India generates steam in community boilers and distributes it, along with purchased third-party steam and separated/compressed nitrogen, through a dedicated pipeline network to industrial customers located in Gujarat's GIDC clusters. currentContext.expansion: The Company plans eight new or expanded community industrial gas facilities - Nandesari (Phase 2, 30 TPH, non-fossil fuel), Jhagadia (30 TPH, coal), Vapi (Phase 3, 30 TPH, non-fossil fuel), Dahej SEZ (30 TPH, coal), Ankleshwar (Phase 3, 60 TPH, coal), Pirana/Ahmedabad (30 TPH, non-fossil fuel), Panoli (Phase 2, 60 TPH, coal) and Tarapur (60 TPH, coal). Once completed, steam distribution capacity rises from 345 TPH to 675 TPH, i.e. annual installed capacity from 2,185,920.00 TPA to 4,276,800.00 TPA (assuming 330 operational days and 80% boiler efficiency).
